metadata.title: Replay and Retention

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for governing message retention, replay, and reprocessing without enabling abuse or unintended side effects.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Message retention stores, offsets, checkpoints, replay mechanisms, and reprocessing tooling in integration platforms.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Pattern for managing time as an attack surface in system-to-system integration.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: Replay and retention trust assumes baseline integration identity, ownership, boundary control, and accountability.

metadata.remarks: Replay and Retention defines trust properties required to safely retain and replay integration messages. This pattern addresses replay abuse, side-effect re-triggering, retention scope, and temporal authorization without redefining delivery semantics or message authenticity.

components.title: Message Retention Governance
components.description: Defines how long messages are retained and for what purposes.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Collection or misuse of sensitive information from retained messages.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Lifecycle management to constrain retention duration and scope.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Policies define message retention duration and purpose.
Retention and disposition of messages align with governance requirements.

components.title: Replay Authorization and Control
components.description: Restricts who may initiate message replay and under what conditions.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Abuse of trusted integration controls to trigger unauthorized replay.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Access control restricting replay operations to authorized roles.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Replay actions are authorized before execution.
Replay privileges follow least privilege principles.

components.title: Side-Effect Safety and Idempotency
components.description: Ensures message reprocessing does not re-trigger unsafe side effects.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Replay of messages to cause duplicate or repeated system actions.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Controls ensuring replay-safe and idempotent processing.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Integrity and safety checks prevent harmful side effects during replay.

components.title: Temporal Observability and Audit
components.description: Provides traceability of retention and replay actions over time.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Suppression of evidence related to replay or retention misuse.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Audit logging of retention policy enforcement and replay actions.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Retention and replay events are logged.
Audit review supports investigation of temporal misuse.
